shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat wall surface
horizontal groundline or border band at the base
justification: Both are shallow relief scenes with profile figures resting on a horizontal baseline band, but that is about as generic as relief carving gets. A shows a ceremonial scene of standing human figures with tall crowns beneath a rayed disc above an offering table and dense columns of script, while B shows a large naturalistic wounded animal collapsing over its forelegs with no human figures, no disc and no writing.
